= Broad Strokes =

== Design ==

For all activity interactions with other servers my local actor is now an `agent`, the other remains the `actor`.

=== Serving ===

The application runs as a `fastcgi` script behind `nginx`. This avoids having a
running process and seems to me to be adequate for my purposes.

The entry point for the application is `index.js` which initializes the local
`.env` files and loads the `cgi.js` from the `bin` folder.

=== Folders ===

The base folders of the project are:

  * `assets`: Contains `.js` and `.css` files that are loaded via `nginx`.
  * `bin`: Contains only `cgi.js` as described above.
  * `lib`: Very much the body of the application.
  * `routes`: Handles the routing.
  * `socket`: Handles calls from the browser end.
  * `tests`: Contains tests - TODO - needs more work.
